description: Go-produced vectors (pkg/evm/stawi Commitment) for packages/finance_sdk voteCommitment: keccak256(abi.encode(uint8 choice, bytes32 salt, uint256 proposalId, address member)), the commitment a COMMIT_VOTE room call carries and GovernanceModule.revealVote checks. room_votes are the CAST_VOTE, COMMIT_VOTE and REVEAL_VOTE room calls (pkg/evm/stawi Call.TypedHash): typed_hash = keccak256(abi.encode(typehash, verifier, chainId, member, nonce, deadline) ++ params) with params the call's ABI words (proposalId, choice | commitment | choice and salt), and digest = AccountWrappedHash(member, chainId, typed_hash), what the member's device signs.
